title: Design: long and special tier names in the Part Sale Priced By column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, so the stress tiers have a matrix to price from.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have three new customers for this test, customers A, B and C, on tiers A, B and C for Part Sales, each with a Part Sale holding a part in category A, so each tier prices one part.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's Part Sale.
  2. Open customer B's Part Sale.
  3. Open customer C's Part Sale.
  4. Point at the part's Priced By value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A's name shows in Priced By, wrapped or shortened with "..." inside its cell.
  • Margin, Category and Vendor stay in place.

Step 2:

  • Tier B's name stays inside its cell.
  • Every column of the parts table stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.

Step 3:

  • Tier C's name shows character for character, & " ' < > included.

Step 4:

  • The price details show tier C's name in full inside the panel.
  • The panel's rows stay readable.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
